relations.subject: Philip Yampolsky
relations.object: Publication Committee at the Numata Center
relations.evidence: In December 1991, the Publication Committee was organized at the Numata Center, with Professor Philip Yampolsky as the Chairperson. To our sorrow, Professor Yampolsky passed away in July 1996.

relations.evidence: in that capacity until August 1999. The current Chair, Dr. Francis H. Cook, has been continuing the work since October 1999.

relations.subject: Francis H. Cook
